snippet.title: Legendary Pilots Launches April 21 | Career Flight Sim Announcement
snippet.description:
Legendary Pilots takes off on April 21.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393730/Legendary_Pilots/

Step into a stylised aviation world where your career is the real journey. Fly turboprops and regional jets, manage your fleet, plan routes, and build your reputation in a dynamic airline ecosystem.

Blending accessible flight mechanics with deeper management systems, Legendary Pilots offers a fresh take on the genre - focused on progression, strategy, and the life of a pilot beyond the cockpit.

From your first flight to becoming an established professional, every decision shapes your path through the skies.
